title: US Tweaks Debt-Sale Guidance, Signals Auction Changes Ahead
summary: The US Treasury Department revamped the guidance on sales of notes and bonds it has used since early 2024, in a move that dealers said opens the door to ​larger sales of short-dated debt and potentially cuts to longer-dated auctions.

title: Malaysia Set to Hold Rates on Strong Growth, Signal Hike in 2027
summary: Malaysia’s central bank is expected to keep interest rates unchanged at its final policy meeting of the year on Thursday while signaling scope for a hike early in 2027 as economic growth remains strong.

title: Host Hotels & Resorts CEO on 3Q Quarterly Results

He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Defense Stocks in US, Europe Drop After Democrats Sweep Midterms

title: Australia’s Heavy October Rainfall Sparks Grain Quality Concerns

Tech megacaps also jumped as investors bet a Democratic-controlled Congress will force companies to carry out AI spending cuts that they’ve been calling for.
